npcs.name: Mira Ashkettle
npcs.description: Familiar face at a busy local tavern; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Mira Ashkettle works from a busy local tavern with the stubborn patience of a 42-year-old Halfling who has already survived harder seasons. She polishes a dented copper mug between orders, and keeps the chalk tally board behind the bar close when tempers rise. Married to Bren; employs Pippa and Hound Garrik. Her private aim is simple: buy the empty lot next door for a beer garden. Still, she flinches at the thought of debt collectors spooking her evening crowd. Lately a fresh problem has landed in her lap: A bloodstained cloak left on stool seven holds a noble signet in the hem.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; polishes a dented copper mug between orders.
npcs.motivation: Protect her livelihood long enough to buy the empty lot next door for a beer garden.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: A bloodstained cloak left on stool seven holds a noble signet in the hem.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Mira knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Measured halfling cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn halfling garb; the chalk tally board behind the bar always nearby.

relationships.note: Trains and protects Pippa on busy nights.

npcs.name: Bren Ashkettle
npcs.description: Familiar face at the tavern cellar; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Walk into the tavern cellar and you will find Bren Ashkettle before you find a free chair. A 44-year-old Halfling cellar master, Bren greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. He sniffs every bung before he trusts it. The ring of cellar keys worn shiny travels with him almost everywhere. Mira's spouse and cellar master. His ambition is to retire the smoky old boil kettle for a proper brew setup. His nightmare is contraband in his casks ruining Mira's name. Right now, Two casks bear burned smuggler marks under the wax he only found at midnight.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; sniffs every bung before he trusts it.
npcs.motivation: Protect his livelihood long enough to retire the smoky old boil kettle for a proper brew setup.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Two casks bear burned smuggler marks under the wax he only found at midnight.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Bren knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Measured halfling cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn halfling garb; the ring of cellar keys worn shiny always nearby.

npcs.name: Pippa Reed
npcs.description: Familiar face at the tavern floor; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Pippa Reed works from the tavern floor with the stubborn patience of a 19-year-old Human who has already survived harder seasons. She hums while she stacks tankards too fast, and keeps the ribbon from her sister tied on her wrist close when tempers rise. Employee of Mira; sweet on Tomas Reedpike. Her private aim is simple: save enough to apprentice with a seamstress. Still, she flinches at the thought of being sent back to the mill if she breaks too many mugs. Lately a fresh problem has landed in her lap: She overheard Cal Drownwick promise a 'soft job' to a cloaked stranger.

npcs.motivation: Protect her livelihood long enough to save enough to apprentice with a seamstress.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: She overheard Cal Drownwick promise a 'soft job' to a cloaked stranger.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the tavern floor on a night Pippa worked late.

npcs.appearance: Work-worn human garb; the ribbon from her sister tied on her wrist always nearby.

npcs.name: Hound Garrik
npcs.description: Familiar face at the tavern doorway; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Hound Garrik's reputation as a bouncer was built one careful errand at a time around the tavern doorway. Age 36 sits lightly on this Half-Orc, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that he counts exits before he counts customers. The notched oak club hung by the coat pegs is part tool, part talisman. Mira's bouncer; once served under Serra's predecessor. He would trade sleep to earn a quiet room upstairs and a steady wage forever, yet stays wary of hurting someone who didn't deserve it in a brawl. Current spark: Recognized a wanted tattoo on a 'merchant' who fled when met his eyes.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; counts exits before he counts customers.
npcs.motivation: Protect his livelihood long enough to earn a quiet room upstairs and a steady wage forever.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Recognized a wanted tattoo on a 'merchant' who fled when met his eyes.
npcs.rumor: Locals whisper that the notched oak club hung by the coat pegs once belonged to a traveler who vanished on the road.
npcs.voice: Measured half-orc cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn half-orc garb; the notched oak club hung by the coat pegs always nearby.

npcs.name: Old Tallow
npcs.description: A fireplace regular rooted at a fireside bench in the tavern, known for how he taps the hearthstones when a story turns true.
npcs.biography: Before dawn, Old is already at a fireside bench in the tavern, working as a fireplace regular with yesterday's work still on his fingers. The habit everyone notices is simple: he taps the hearthstones when a story turns true. Close by sits his prized the pipe carved like a sleeping hound, a small anchor in a loud settlement. Retired carter; friend to Nell and Jab. He wants to see the summer fair one more year. He fears dying with his best stories untold more than open confrontation. A useful adventure hook trails him: Swears he saw lanterns moving under the an abandoned mill three nights running.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; taps the hearthstones when a story turns true.
npcs.motivation: To see the the summer fair one more year, even while fearing dying with his best stories untold.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Swears he saw lanterns moving under the an abandoned mill three nights running.
npcs.rumor: Old is said to keep a private list of debts local officials will not touch.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A human silhouette framed by a fireside bench in the tavern, hands seldom empty of the pipe carved like a sleeping hound.

npcs.name: Sela Vintner
npcs.description: The wine seller people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Sela Vintner works from a wine corner in the local tavern with the stubborn patience of a 31-year-old Half-Elf who has already survived harder seasons. She rolls corks between her fingers while she listens, and keeps the travel-stained sample case of rare vintages close when tempers rise. Supplies Mira; trades rumors with Jor Sandline. Her private aim is simple: open a tasting room with Mira next spring. Still, she flinches at the thought of her along the trade road supplier being replaced by smugglers. Lately a fresh problem has landed in her lap: A bottle she sold as orchard white tasted of river silt and iron.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; rolls corks between her fingers while she listens.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to open a tasting room with Mira next spring.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to her along the trade road supplier being replaced by smugglers, especially since: A bottle she sold as orchard white tasted of river silt and iron.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near a wine corner in the local tavern on a night Sela worked late.
npcs.voice: Quick local diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near a wine corner in the local tavern: half-elf, practical layers, and the travel-stained sample case of rare vintages.

npcs.name: Jory Mugwright
npcs.description: A taproom cook rooted at the tavern kitchen, known for how he tastes stew with the same wooden spoon for luck.
npcs.biography: Some locals swear Jory was born mid-shift at the tavern kitchen; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This dwarf taproom cook, now 88, treats competence like courtesy. He tastes stew with the same wooden spoon for luck, never far from the spice box with a false bottom for salt pork money. Cook for Mira; buys barrels from Cooper Brenwick. Ask what he wants and he names it plainly: publish a chapbook of 'proper dwarf stews for soft southern mouths'. Ask what he dreads and the answer is the roof leaking into his flour again. Then comes the fresh problem—Found a coded note pinned under a delivery crate of turnips.

npcs.motivation: To publish a chapbook of 'proper dwarf stews for soft southern mouths', even while fearing the roof leaking into his flour again.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Found a coded note pinned under a delivery crate of turnips.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the tavern kitchen on a night Jory worked late.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A dwarf silhouette framed by the tavern kitchen, hands seldom empty of the spice box with a false bottom for salt pork money.

npcs.name: Nessa Brightcup
npcs.description: Familiar face at a small stage in the local tavern; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Before dawn, Nessa is already at a small stage in the local tavern, working as a evening singer with yesterday's work still on her fingers. The habit everyone notices is simple: she tunes her lute to the room's mood before she smiles. Close by sits her prized the songbook with pages swapped for maps, a small anchor in a loud settlement. Performs at Mira's; shares rooms sometimes with Rilo. She wants to earn a noble patronage without losing the common room. She fears a past patron recognizing her from another town's scandal more than open confrontation. A useful adventure hook trails her: Her new ballad names a 'pale clerk' who sells signatures by moonlight.

npcs.name: Cal Drownwick
npcs.description: The dice dealer people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Cal Drownwick works from a corner dice table with the stubborn patience of a 27-year-old Human who has already survived harder seasons. He laughs one beat late when the dice betray him, and keeps the weighted knucklebone die he never uses in his own tavern close when tempers rise. Debtor to Marrow; acquaintance of Rook. His private aim is simple: win one clean stake large enough to leave town smiling. Still, he flinches at the thought of Marrow Cline collecting more than coin. Lately a fresh problem has landed in his lap: Steered a drunk grain merchant toward Rook Vell for a cut.
